protocol.scope: Adaptive development follow-up motivated by the inspected depth results. Not a fresh test set, not a guarantee about future photos.
protocol.hypothesis: A depth expert can complement the original predictor without being trusted for every prediction.
protocol.data: Same 524 LeFood records, five original outer splits, 50 calibration labels and original inner folds. Original targets and images unchanged.
protocol.experts: Original Change bank selected by inner group MAE; depth expert selected from the two frozen depth feature families and 13 candidates each by inner group MAE. No outer labels used for expert, policy or weight selection.

policies.BoundedDownward: baseline + alpha * clip(depth - baseline, -0.10, 0); at most ten percentage points downward, never upward

protocol.structural_gate: Both photos must have valid local depth-reference rings. This is a geometry availability check, not calibrated confidence. Otherwise baseline is returned.
protocol.inner_weight_selection: For each policy, minimum group-balanced inner MAE among weights that do not increase recorded-zero predictions above 10% or worsen small-positive group MAE by more than 1 point. Absent inner slices provide no evidence and are explicitly counted. Alpha zero is always available and wins ties. Expert and blend choices share inner data; only outer forecasts assess the full selected procedure.
protocol.report: All outer forecasts, selected expert/weight per fold, slice errors, per-group improvements/regressions, conditional paired dependency-block intervals. No choosing the policy from a gallery example.
protocol.promotion: No automatic deployment. Report whether overall error does not increase, small-positive degradation is <=1 point, zero-above-10% count does not increase, and the paired-block 95% interval is entirely below zero. Independent new-serving confirmation is still needed.

Blend.scope: Conditional development interval for saved outer forecasts; does not include new training runs, label error or institution shift.

BoundedDownward.scope: Conditional development interval for saved outer forecasts; does not include new training runs, label error or institution shift.
